send_generate.text: I ask the miller where his son was last seen and promise to bring him back.
I follow the wet footprints down to the old cellar behind the granary.
I kick the cellar door in and shove the guard against the wall until he drops the keys.
I unlock the chain, lift the boy out and carry him back to the mill.
